# spark-data-quality

> Deequ-style data quality checks with mergeable per-partition analyzer states, metric-history anomaly detection and JSON or Markdown verification reports Scala library `io.github.trysac:spark-data-quality`, package
> `io.github.trysac.spark_data_quality`, MIT licensed, Scala 3 on Java >= 21, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
